response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), profile_stats AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM filtered GROUP BY weathprofile), mean_of_avgs AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_avg FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bandusage, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bandusage - m.mean_avg AS deviation_from_mean FROM profile_stats p CROSS JOIN mean_of_avgs m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes are matched to observatories with an inner join, so telescopes whose observstation has no observatory row are dropped. Telescopes with a NULL detecttempk are excluded because NULL > 152.1 is not true.
The telescope count includes telescopes whose bandusagepct is missing; only the average ignores missing values.
Telescopes whose observatory has a NULL weathprofile form their own group rather than being dropped.

The mean of per-profile averages is computed with AVG over the profile averages, so profiles whose average is NULL (all bandusagepct missing) are ignored in that mean but still appear in the output with a NULL deviation. The result is empty when that mean is NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only telescopes that have a non-missing bandusagepct, so the telescope count matches the rows that contribute to the average.
